categories.main_business_segments: Oracle Corporation Japan operates three main business segments: Cloud & License (including cloud services, license support, and on-premises software licenses), Hardware Systems (sales and support of servers, storage, engineered systems, and network equipment), and Services (consulting and advanced customer support for Oracle products). The Cloud & License segment is the largest, accounting for over 84% of total revenue, followed by Services and Hardware Systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages Oracle Corporation's core technologies, including relational database management systems, middleware, enterprise applications (ERP, etc.), and cloud infrastructure (OCI). Products and services are developed and maintained by Oracle Corporation globally, with Oracle Corporation Japan acting as a distributor and service provider for the Japanese market. The company does not conduct its own R&D but collaborates closely with Oracle Corporation to localize and adapt products for Japan.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Oracle Corporation Japan serves a broad range of customers, including large enterprises, SMEs, government agencies, educational institutions, and public sector organizations. Key industries include manufacturing, distribution, finance, telecommunications, and services. Major customers include system integrators and IT partners such as NEC and Fujitsu, who resell Oracle products and services to end users.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Japan, with offices and service centers across major regions including Tokyo, Osaka, Nagoya, Fukuoka, Sapporo, Kanazawa, Sendai, Okinawa, and Hiroshima. Over 90% of revenue is generated from Japanese customers, and all fixed assets are located in Japan.
categories.supply_chain_position: Oracle Corporation Japan functions as a downstream distributor and service provider, acting as the primary sales and support channel for Oracle products in Japan. It procures software, hardware, and cloud services from Oracle Corporation and its affiliates, and delivers these to end customers either directly or via a network of partner companies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include accelerating cloud adoption (especially Oracle Cloud Infrastructure), supporting customers' migration of mission-critical systems to the cloud, and promoting the use of AI and data-driven business transformation. The company emphasizes 'cloud for Japan' and 'AI for customers' as key themes, including sovereign cloud initiatives and government cloud solutions. R&D is conducted by Oracle Corporation globally; Oracle Corporation Japan focuses on localization, customer support, and integration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through a mix of software license sales, cloud service subscriptions (SaaS, PaaS, IaaS), hardware product sales, technical support contracts, and consulting/services fees. Cloud and support services are primarily subscription-based, while software and hardware are sold on a license or product basis. The company pays royalties to Oracle Corporation based on sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include global and domestic IT vendors such as Microsoft, Amazon Web Services, SAP, IBM, and local system integrators. Oracle Corporation Japan is a leading provider of enterprise IT infrastructure and cloud solutions in Japan, with a strong position in mission-critical database and ERP systems. The company differentiates itself through its integrated portfolio and deep expertise in both cloud and on-premises environments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending May 2025, Oracle Corporation Japan reported revenues of 263.5 billion yen (approx. $1.7 billion), up 7.8% year-on-year, with operating profit of 86.8 billion yen and net profit of 60.7 billion yen. The company has over 2,250 employees and continues to achieve record-high revenues and profits, driven by growth in cloud services and support.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Oracle Corporation Japan emphasizes its ability to provide a comprehensive, integrated IT platform spanning cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments, with high security, reliability, and performance for mission-critical applications. Its value proposition includes seamless migration paths, advanced AI capabilities, and strong local support, enabling customers to modernize legacy systems and drive digital transformation with confidence.
